description: Published local cells too small to bind (microcosm#1123 item 7, in the pattern of the #762 A14 band-H deferral). The local generator defers, by rule rather than by area name, every active cell of a matching target whose published value is below the rule's absolute floor; reconciliation still counts a deferred cell's value in its leg's control, so deferring it does not inflate its neighbours. The runtime refuses a deferral past its expiry. approved_by/approved_on stay null until María signs the floor.

rules.reason: A council-tax band cell of fewer than 50 dwellings (Blaenau Gwent band H 3, Barking and Dagenham band G 49) cannot be met by a sample of households: the capped loss stops paying for it and it sits past the target-fit fence for good (microcosm#1123 item 7). The deferred cell's dwellings still count in its leg's band control through reconciliation.
